title: Help desk instance as code (CDK)
scenario: LFG deploys one Connect instance per environment from one CDK app. The hand-written pilot stack has no routing profiles, UTC hours, outage reports bouncing at 8 PM and dev ARNs string-replaced into the inbound flow, so prod would point at dev resources. Make it config-driven and environment-safe; synth is offline.
task: Instance with SAML, flow logs, Contact Lens, early media; retained in prod; tagged
Hours per config with time zone; holidays as CLOSED overrides on staffed hours only
Queues on their own hours; routing profiles with voice/chat concurrency, priority and delay
Lex V2 bot with intents and fallback, numbered version, live alias, Connect association
Flow content via Fn::Sub resolving every placeholder to this stack's resources
acceptance: aws-cdk-lib/assertions checks pass for dev and prod
Unknown queue, unknown placeholder or unknown environment fail synth with a clear message
No account-specific ARN in the flow body
ANSWER.md covers CFN gaps for Connect and flow promotion
